title: tasksource: A Dataset Harmonization Framework for Streamlined NLP Multi-Task Learning and Evaluation
findings: The paper does not report specific findings related to religion. The overall finding is that a model fine-tuned on the diverse 'tasksource' collection, which includes some religion-related datasets (e.g., stance on atheism, world religions), achieves strong general performance on an external evaluation.
references: Journal of Applied Non-Classical Logics, pages 1-17.
